source_name: Держстат — Єдиний державний реєстр підприємств та організацій України (ЄДРПОУ)
why_relevant: The statistical register behind the EDRPOU identifier system, maintained by Держстат. Useful as the canonical explanation and, where published, as a source of the identifier-to-entity mapping and KVED classification used across all Ukrainian registers. Secondary to the Мін'юст ЄДР for live company facts but valuable for classification consistency.

source_name: PECB Ukraine — ISO/IEC 27001 certification and lead-auditor training body
why_relevant: Ukrainian arm of a management-system certification body; ISMS lead-auditor certificates from PECB/MSECB are one of the qualifications Держспецзв'язку accepts for attested information-security auditors, linking the training market to the attested-auditor population.

Supplier of deposit safes and bank-grade security equipment (e.g. VALBERG models) for bank cash centres and CIT vehicles, a segment the NBU regulates. Indirectly reveals which security-equipment brands are approved for UA banking use.

Second domestic PTKS (payment self-service terminal) manufacturer with 10+ years' production. Reinforces the local-manufacture segment; listing sits on the prom.ua marketplace layer, useful as a discovery channel for smaller vendors.

UPC is the dominant card-processing incumbent serving banks across Ukraine and neighbouring CEE markets and is the named counterparty in the Tietoevry open-banking partnership. It is both a competitor and a channel partner for POS/ATM vendors. The Wikipedia entry is recorded here as an English-language entry point and disambiguation aid; the company's own site should be located and substituted as the primary node.

source_name: Український кредитно-банківський союз (УКБС / Ukrainian Credit-Banking Union)
why_relevant: Third banking association (originated as the Kyiv Banking Union in 1994, renamed 2005), reported to unite ~92 financial and credit institutions plus foreign-institution representatives. Third overlapping roster helps triangulate the full bank universe and catch institutions absent from NABU/AUB. The Wikipedia entry is recorded here as the reliable entry point because the union's own domain was not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: Work.ua resume database (CVs of banking/ATM service engineers)
why_relevant: Candidate CVs list the exact hardware and software stacks they operated and at which employer — e.g. a service engineer citing Wincor/NCR/Diebold ATMs and Glory sorters. CVs expose incumbent fleets and outsourcing partners that no vendor publishes.
Business desk of a large Ukrainian news site with a continuous finance/business feed; useful as a breadth backstop for bank and state-procurement stories that the specialist outlets miss.

source_name: Printec Ukraine LLC (ПРІНТЕК УКРАЇНА ЕЛ.ЕЛ.СІ., EDRPOU 35442628)
why_relevant: The multinational transactional-technology integrator's Ukrainian entity (founded 2007), serving financial institutions, retail, telecom and government. Its own site and the group's UA financial-results disclosures are the reference point against which local integrator competitors should be benchmarked. NOTE: 'printec.com.ua' and 'printec.ua' are unrelated Ukrainian businesses with a colliding name — do not conflate.
